scientific_integrity: The new claim concerns an explicit model-specific nonlinear branch. Existing synchronized linear stability and strong-coupling travelling checkerboard results are credited. Finite numerical checks corroborate, not certify, the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Local bifurcation for each fixed even finite ring, not a global attractor or infinite-lattice classification; historical priority can never be exhaustively guaranteed.
title: A subcritical checkerboard pitchfork at the synchronized two-cycle stability edge
